title: Chapter 455 The Army Approaches
content:
Chapter 455 The Army Approaches

Outside the Chaos Realm.

His divine eyes suddenly shook, and an inexplicable sense of oppression suddenly came. He felt that there seemed to be a pair of eye-catching eyes staring at him.

Not only him, but other powerful people in other worlds are like this, restless.

Click—

At this moment, a sudden change broke out, and a crisp sound rang out from the light curtain, and the entire light curtain was shattered.

The entire Chaos Realm was immediately completely exposed to the eyes of the powerful people in the other world without any warning.

Even the supreme laws of the Chaos Realm, which were once high, have been restrained and moved without any movement.

"this,,"

His divine eyes stood there, and he was at a loss.

Even the sickle weasel, who had always been crazy, did not rush into the Chaos Realm as soon as possible, but instead dragged the sickle and retreated slightly.

“There is something weird.”

The third eye on the forehead of the divine eyes was flashing with light at this moment, looking tightly inside the Chaos Realm.

A group of strong men were slowly coming towards this side, with a deep breath.

On the other hand, all the strong men who entered the Chaos Realm fell, and everything happened in a moment.

It's really too sudden.

They were so eager and eager to invade the Chaos Realm, but now there is no stop to the Chaos Realm and is close at hand, but they hesitate.

Intuition tells them that there must be big problems in the chaos world.

In the Chaos Realm.

Lu Xue looked at the powerful men in the deserted city who suddenly appeared and the mysterious strong men who walked out of the city lord's mansion, with a complex expression.

These people walked to Lu Xue and all bowed together.

The strong man from the city lord's mansion said to Lu Xue, "Miss, I've been waiting for you for a long time."

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue just smiled and said nothing.

At critical moments, it’s up to your own father.

These people are all powerful people trained by Lu Daosheng secretly. From his debut to the present, they have never been revealed.

And this time, facing the land of the gods, this force that had been hidden all the time finally showed its edge.

The strong man in charge looked at the powerful man in another world outside the Chaos Realm with a cold voice and a strong murderous intent, and said, "Kill!"

Suddenly, the battle situation reversed.

Countless strong people in the Chaos Realm roared towards the creatures in the other world outside the Chaos Realm.

Outside the Chaos Realm, the powerful people in the other world were shocked to see this.

It has always been their conquest of others, or the first time they were attacked by someone.

The Scytheita smiled coldly, and regained her crazy face again, and said coldly: "I want to see if I kill you or you kill me."

With a whoosh.

The sickle-i-it-i-shot shot towards the powerful people in the Chaos Realm.

The divine eyes retreated slightly, his face was solemn, and he waved his hand, "Go up."

Suddenly, the army of the land of the gods was pressing over, and a vast area was filled with darkness. In the eyes of the people in the Chaos Realm, the sky was already dark and covered by the army of the land of the gods.

How many are there?

Although under the unstoppable attack of the powerful people in the deserted city, the land of the gods still caused heavy casualties in the Chaos Realm based on the advantages of the army.

The army's advantages were immediately visible.

There are naturally troops in the Chaos Realm, but most of them are relatively small in scale and very complicated, and they cannot be used directly.

It’s not easy to feel like this in the Chaos Realm, and the same is true for this in the Land of Gods.

Looking at the unprecedented casualties, his divine eyes looked ugly. He couldn't understand how such a powerful force suddenly emerged in this unknown small world.

It's simply unprecedented and unheard of.

However, from the overall perspective, they still have an advantage.

That sudden force just gave the Chaos Realm the capital to fight back.

Even if they can't do anything at the moment, when the army arrives, they will be able to completely break the Chaos Realm.

Just as the divine eyes thought this way, the black hole behind him suddenly began to get restless.

His divine eyes were slightly stunned, and he felt the familiar aura behind him, and was immediately overjoyed.

"The Lord Priest is here!"

The army is coming.

The aura gushed out from the black hole countless times more than all the powerful people in the other world.

This breath poured into the chaos realm through the void, causing countless creatures to feel despair and suffocation.

Can they really win?

This question filled my heart, but then it was fleeting.

Now, they can only believe it.

Believe in Huangcheng, believe in that adult.

Lu Xue and others' faces suddenly looked extremely ugly, and if this happens, they will fall into a desperate situation again.

But at this time, Ao Qing rushed forward with a slight fear.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue looked surprised and suspicious.

Faced with this extremely unequal strength of both sides, what gave Ao Qing the courage.

Lu Xue was a little anxious and quickly sent a message saying, "Xiaoqing, come back soon, are you looking for death?"

Ao Qing alone will be torn to pieces when facing the land of the gods.

But Aoqing laughed.

"My little master, don't you understand yet? The master has removed the last barrier in the Chaos Realm. Isn't he meant to let us fight back?"

"But we don't have enough manpower."

Lu Xue understood this, but was still a little worried.

Ao Qing smiled and said, "That's not what we should consider."

Ao Qing really believes in Lu Daosheng unconditionally.

Lu Xue stood there in a daze, and was also a little moved.

Then she was suddenly stunned again. When did she become so restricted? She used to be afraid of heaven and earth.

Why are you so cautious now when facing a land of gods?

Suddenly, the messy emotions in Lu Xue's heart dissipated, and an extremely relaxed feeling surged into her body, and then filled her whole body.

She suddenly smiled and looked at the creatures in the other world outside the sky that covered the sky. She had no restraint in her eyes, but she felt a little more disdainful.

"A group of scumbags dare to anger my deserted city and seek death!"

The sound of the sword sounded.

Lu Xue held the Xuanyuan Sword in her hand and immediately turned into a sword light and headed towards the army in another world, and soon caught up with Ao Qing.

Seeing Lu Xue like this, the strong men in the Chaos Realm and the Wilderness City were shocked, but immediately, they followed Lu Xue.

"Protect Miss Lu Xue!"

Outside the Chaos Realm, the powerful people in the other world were stunned when they saw that the Chaos Realm did not retreat but advanced.

"Are these ants scared silly?"

"Haha, it's just a counterattack before death."

"Kill, kill all these ants!"

Boom!

The entire void outside the world exploded, and a magnificent wave of air burst out.

The two sides confronted each other head-on. For a moment, the Chaos Realm gained the upper hand in a short period of time with its strong belief and sharp offensive.

There was a sneer on the corner of his divine eyes and his eyes looked at the large army that was already close behind him, and his confidence increased greatly.

"Continue to kill, don't retreat!"

Soon, the priests from the Land of Gods led the elite troops of the Land of Gods to cross the black hole and completely stood outside the Chaos Realm.

"Is this the Chaos Realm that God calls it?"

"Huh? Are the creatures in this world so crazy?"

The priest glanced at the audience, and an invisible sense of oppression swept across the entire battlefield.

Lu Xue noticed this aura and immediately carried the Xuanyuan Sword and rushed towards the priest.
